text: the browser dropped the storage of the database {name}, which this browser had open before, as Chromium does with a private window's storage after ten minutes with no database open; its changes the relay had not confirmed are lost. Tell the user, then open with ifStorageLost: "open-empty" to start an empty copy
when: nc.open in a browser, when this browser context had the database open before and its files on OPFS are gone while IndexedDB kept the record, as after Chromium drops a private window's OPFS (NOC-445).
